build_kernel_ridge_model: build a kernel ridge regressor with an exponential sine squared kernel to fit periodic data
test_randomized_search_tune_kernel_ridge: test randomized search to tune kernel ridge hyperparameters including alpha, length scale, and periodicity
create_gaussian_process_regressor: create a Gaussian process regressor with an exponential sine squared kernel and white kernel for noise estimation
refactor_gpr_with_rbf_kernel: refactor the Gaussian process regressor with a radial basis function kernel to attenuate periodicity extrapolation
review_ridge_regression_underfit: review ridge regression limitations by fitting a linear model to periodic sine wave data
